answer: Make trust a trellis that can only be grown, never bought. A new agent enters through a narrow inlet and may take only small jobs; each job it completes earns a strand of reputation vouched for by the peer it served, and strands interlock so no single fake sponsor can lift an identity far. To forge a thousand Sybils, an attacker must pay for a thousand honest job histories, one verified task at a time. Volume collapses against that work requirement, while a genuine newcomer climbs the same lattice at the honest pace of real contributions.
